about: UC-29 the fighters: each a Meshy model, rigged and animated in Meshy (Animate, Mixamo skeleton), prepared by tools/prep_fighter.py into data/meshes/fight/<key>.glb. 'clips' maps a state of fight/rules.js to the Meshy motion played for it. A JOKE: Doc Fee is made up.

buyer.name: You
buyer.made: Meshy Image (Nano Banana Pro, A-pose) then Image to 3D (Meshy 7.1, texture Meshy 7 2K), remesh 30K triangles, Animate (humanoid rig) 2026-11-07
buyer.prompt: Full-body 3D game character, A-pose, front view, head to toe in frame: an everyday car buyer turned street fighter, a determined man in his thirties with short dark hair and stubble, a grey zip hoodie over a white t-shirt, dark blue jeans, white sneakers, a car key on a lanyard round his neck, stylized fighting-game proportions, plain light grey background, soft even lighting, no text.
